newsitem.title: USA: Donnelley sees 96 net below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Donnelley sees 96 net below estimates.

text.p: Donnelley Enterprise Solutions Inc said on Thursday it expects its 1996 net income will be "substantially less" than analysts' estimates.
The company said it expects 1996 net income to be between $600,000 and $900,000, compared to $300,000 in 1995.
It also said its 1996 revenues will be about $95 to $98 million, up from 1995 revenues of $65.9 million, but below analysts' estimates.
Wall Street is expecting the company to report profits of $0.17 per share for the quarter and $0.39 per share for the year, according to First Call.

The company attributed its outlook to a revenue shortfall in its LANSystems division, which it said saw substantially increased costs due to a shortage of service delivery employees, a transition in management, increased use of subcontracted labour and lower productivity from new employees.
The company said it had moved to address the operating issues and expects to report its results the week of February 17.
